messages:
emma: Hey team — we need to finalize the metric set and dashboard layout for the new prefix-store effectiveness work. Product wants clear tenant-level attribution for hits/reuse + eviction patterns. Can we sync on what runtime/infra can emit and what console needs?

devin: +1. My initial ask: per-tenant, per-model prefix_hit_rate, prefix_evictions, prefix_reuse_count. Also a rolling-5m and rolling-1h window. Low-cardinality labels only.

sanjay: From runtime side we can emit base counters: prefix_hits_total, prefix_misses_total, prefix_evictions_total, cache_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket. We can add labels: tenant_id, model_name, shard_type. Concern: tenant_id cardinality — need sampling for huge tenants.

lara: infra: agree on sampling. We can support a sampling flag that tags a small percentage of requests with tenant_id full label and otherwise emit tenant_bucket (e.g., "small|medium|large") to keep series count down. Also can provide aggregated per-tenant rollups in ClickHouse ingestion.

noah: For Console dashboards we want: hit rate by tenant (pct), eviction rate per 10k requests, reuse_by_workload heatmap, and time-to-first-hit distribution. Also a top-20 tenants view with cost attribution. UX: show trend (24h, 7d) and allow drilling to request examples.

ravi: Two important definitions to lock down: 1) prefix_hit_rate = prefix_hits_total / (prefix_hits_total + prefix_misses_total) 2) reuse_by_workload = distinct_prefix_reuse_events / total_requests_by_workload. We should add a consistent label for workload (route/endpoint) e.g., workload="chat_completion".

emma: @sanjay @lara can you confirm that runtime can add workload label? also we need eviction reason label (eviction_reason: capacity|ttl|manual).

sanjay: We can add workload label at the request-mapping layer. Eviction reason can be surfaced from the cache manager API. Will add eviction_reason label but limit to the three values.

lara: On ingestion we will normalize eviction_reason to those three values and drop unknowns. We'll also create a low-cardinality derived label tenant_size_bucket for dashboards.

noah: For sampling strategy, propose: 0.5% full-tenant labels globally, and 100% for tenants flagged as "diagnostic". We'll also capture a sample id to join logs if needed. Thoughts?

devin: 0.5% seems ok for long-tail analysis. For SLOs we still need accurate aggregates; so use aggregated counters (no labels) + sampled label streams. Example: prefix_hits_agg_total (no tenant label) + prefix_hits_sampled_total{tenant_id}.

ravi: Need clarity on cardinality: sampled streams add series but are manageable. Also propose we emit prefix_warmth gauge (0-1) per model_name and shard_type to measure how "hot" prefixes are.

emma: Nice. Console layout proposal: top row overall hit rate + evictions; middle: per-workload reuse heatmap; bottom: tenant table with cost, hit rate, recent evictions, and links to traces. Include quick filters for model_name, workload, tenant_size_bucket.

noah: I'll sketch the dashboard. Quick note on aggregation windows: use rate() over 5m for short-term, increase to 1h for stability. For sampled counters we'll extrapolate to estimate tenant totals (with uncertainty band).

sanjay: Implementation plan: runtime emits new metrics in v0.28, feature flag gated. We'll add prometheus exposition for agg counters + sampled streams, and a kafka topic with detailed eviction events for infra rollups.

lara: Infra will add the Kafka ingest consumer and create daily rollups in ClickHouse. We'll also produce a per-tenant daily table for billing/attribution.

emma: Action items: 1) sanjay - PR to runtime with metric names + feature flag by Tue. 2) lara - ingest consumer + schema + tenant_bucket mapping by Fri. 3) noah - dashboard mockups by Wed. 4) devin - doc for console UX and filters by Thu. 5) ravi - definitions doc + example queries.

deploy-bot: deploy-signal: metric-emitter/v0.28 deployed to staging at 2024-05-21T18:12:03Z :rocket:

devin: small follow-up: please use these exact metric names to avoid confusion: prefix_hits_total, prefix_misses_total, prefix_evictions_total, prefix_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket, prefix_warmth_gauge, prefix_reuse_events_total, prefix_eviction_event{eviction_reason}.

ravi: I'll start a shared Confluence page with definitions + PromQL examples and link from the dashboard.

emma: Thanks all. If no objections I'll lock the plan and create the cross-team milestone. :thumbsup:
